simvars.description: Returns whether the autopilot is in Altitude Arm mode (1, TRUE) or not (0, FALSE).

simvars.name: PROP BETA MAX

simvars.name: PROP BETA MIN

simvars.name: PROP BETA MIN REVERSE
units: The "prop beta" is the pitch of the blades of the propeller. This retrieves the minimum possible pitch value when the propeller is in reverse for all engines.

simvars.name: PROP DEICE SWITCH
units: True if prop deice switch on for the indexed engine (see note).

simvars.name: PROP FEATHERED
units: This will return the feathered state of the propeller for an indexed engine (see note). The state is either feathered (true) or not (false).

simvars.name: PROP FEATHERING INHIBIT
units: Feathering inhibit flag for the indexed engine (see note).

simvars.name: PROP FEATHER SWITCH
units: Prop feather switch for the indexed engine (see note).

simvars.name: PROP MAX RPM PERCENT
units: Percent of max rated rpm for the indexed engine (see note). NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all near aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: PROP ROTATION ANGLE
units: Prop rotation angle. NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all near aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: PROP RPM
units: Propeller rpm for the indexed engine (see note).

simvars.name: PROP SYNC ACTIVE
units: True if prop sync is active the indexed engine (see note).

simvars.name: PROP SYNC DELTA LEVER
units: Corrected prop correction input on slaved engine for the indexed engine (see note).

simvars.name: PROP THRUST
units: Propeller thrust for the indexed engine (see note). NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all near aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: SHUTOFF VALVE PULLED
units: This checks if the shutoff valve to the engine has been pulled (true) or not (false). When pulled piston engines will be blocked from getting any fuel.

simvars.name: THROTTLE INPUT BLOCKED BY LOWER BOUNDS
units: Settable boolean triggering the notification for the indexed throttle blocked at the lower bounds when user tries to go past it. When requested with no index parameter
the SimVar will return 1 (TRUE) if any engine index throttle is true. When trying to set the SimVar with no index
then all engine throttles will be set to the specified value.

simvars.name: THROTTLE INPUT BLOCKED BY UPPER BOUNDS
units: Settable boolean triggering the notification for the throttle blocked at the upper bounds when user tries to go past it. When requested with no index parameter
the SimVar will return 1 (TRUE) if any engine index throttle is true. When trying to set the SimVar with no index
then all engine throttles will be set to the specified value.

simvars.name: THROTTLE LOWER LIMIT
units: Percent throttle defining lower limit (negative for reverse thrust equipped airplanes).

simvars.name: TURB ENG AFTERBURNER
units: Afterburner state for the indexed engine (see note). NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all near aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: TURB ENG AFTERBURNER PCT ACTIVE
units: The percentage that the afterburner is running at. NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all near aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: TURB ENG AFTERBURNER STAGE ACTIVE
units: or 0 if the afterburner is not active. NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all near aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: TURB ENG BLEED AIR
units: Bleed air pressure for the indexed engine (see note).

simvars.name: TURB ENG COMMANDED N1
units: Effective commanded N1 for the indexed turbine engine (see note). The way this value is caluclated will depend on the following: For a jet engine the calculation depends on the use_commanded_Ne_table parameter: If true
the return value is calculated depending on use_n2_to_n1_table
commanded Ne and inlet Mach. If false

the return value is equal to commanded Ne. For a turbo-prop or helo-turbine engine the return value is calculated depending on throttle position and mixture control. Also note that while this SimVar is writeable
the written information will be overridden by the simulation on the very next frame.

simvars.name: TURB ENG CONDITION LEVER POSITION
units: When the throttle is on idle position
this sets the condition levers to one of 3 positions to define the idle N1 target for the indexed engine (see note): Down position is the cut-off position that cuts the fuel to the engine

effectively shutting down the engine. Middle position requires N1 to reach the low idle value when throttle is in idle position (low idle value can be checked using the TURB_ENG_LOW_IDLE SimVar). High position requires N1 to reach the high idle value when throttle is in idle position (high idle value can be checked using the TURB_ENG_HIGH_IDLE SimVar). Note that this option requires several settings from the engines.cfg file to be set to specific values before working correctly: DisableMixtureControls needs to be set to 1 (TRUE). tp_idle_range should be set to 0 (since there is no mixture setting). and idle_high_fuel_flow must be set to the same value (since there is no mixture setting to induce a variation between the 2). and high_idle_n1 to be correctly set.

simvars.name: TURB ENG CORRECTED FF
units: Corrected fuel flow for the indexed engine (see note).

simvars.name: TURB ENG CORRECTED N1
units: The indexed turbine engine (see note) corrected N1.

simvars.name: TURB ENG CORRECTED N2
units: The indexed turbine engine (see note) corrected N2.

simvars.name: TURB ENG FREE TURBINE TORQUE
units: The amount of free torque for the indexed turbine engine (see note).

simvars.name: TURB ENG FUEL AVAILABLE
units: True if fuel is available for the indexed engine (see note).

simvars.name: TURB ENG FUEL EFFICIENCY LOSS
units: This is used to control the fuel efficiency loss of the indexed engine
from 0 - no fuel efficiency loss - to 100 - double the fuel consumption.

simvars.name: TURB ENG FUEL FLOW PPH
units: The indexed engine (see note) fuel flow rate.

simvars.name: TURB ENG HIGH IDLE
units: Retrieves the high idle N1 value to be reached by the the indexed turboprop engine (see note) with throttle in idle position and condition lever in high idle position (condition lever position can be checked or set using the TURB_ENG_CONDITION_LEVER_POSITION SimVar).

simvars.name: TURB ENG IGNITION SWITCH
units: True if the the indexed turbine engine (see note) ignition switch is on.

simvars.name: TURB ENG IGNITION SWITCH EX1
units: Position of the the indexed turbine engine (see note) Ignition Switch. Similar to TURB_ENG_IGNITION_SWITCH but differentiates between ON and AUTO.

simvars.name: TURB ENG IS IGNITING
units: Whether or not the ignition system is currently running for the indexed engine (see note). Depends on TURB_ENG_IGNITION_SWITCH_EX1 Enum
the cfg var ignition_auto_type and current state of the plane.

simvars.name: TURB ENG ITT
units: Retrieve or set the ITT for the indexed engine (see note).

simvars.name: TURB ENG ITT COOLING EFFICIENCY LOSS
units: This is used to control the ITT cooling efficiency loss of the indexed engine
from 0 - no cooling efficiency loss - to 100 -engine recieves no ITT cooling.

simvars.name: TURB ENG JET THRUST
units: The indexed engine (see note) jet thrust.

simvars.name: TURB ENG LOW IDLE
units: Retrieves the low idle N1 value to be reached by the the indexed turboprop engine (see note) with throttle in idle position and condition lever in low idle position (condition lever position can be checked or set using the TURB_ENG_CONDITION_LEVER_POSITION SimVar).

simvars.name: TURB ENG MASTER STARTER SWITCH
units: True if the turbine engine master starter switch is on

simvars.name: TURB ENG MAX TORQUE PERCENT
units: Percent of max rated torque for the indexed engine (see note).

simvars.name: TURB ENG N1 LOSS

simvars.name: TURB ENG N2
units: The indexed turbine engine (see note) N2 value. NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all far aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: TURB ENG NUM TANKS USED

simvars.name: TURB ENG PRESSURE RATIO

simvars.name: TURB ENG PRIMARY NOZZLE PERCENT
units: Percent thrust of primary nozzle for the indexed engine (see note).

simvars.name: TURB ENG REVERSE NOZZLE PERCENT
units: Percent thrust reverser nozzles deployed for the indexed engine (see note). NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all far aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

units: The indexed turbine engine (see note) commanded N1 for current throttle position.

units: This can be used to control the thrust efficiency loss of the indexed engine

units: The indexed turbine engine (see note) vibration value.

simvars.name: TURB MAX ITT

units: Carburetor temperature the indexed engine (see note).

units: Alternate air control the indexed engine (see note).

units: The maximum quantity of water/methanol mixture in the ADI tank for the indexed engine (see note). This value is set as part of the [ANTIDETONATION_SYSTEM.N] section in the aircraft configuration files.

units: The status of the ADI tank valve for the indexed engine (see note).

simvars.name: RECIP ENG ANTIDETONATION FLOW RATE
units: This gives the actual flow rate of the Anti Detonation system for the indexed engine (see note).

simvars.name: RECIP ENG BRAKE POWER PCT

units: Percent coolant available for the indexed engine (see note).

units: Percent cowl flap opened for the indexed engine (see note).

units: Engine cylinder head temperature for the indexed engine (see note).

simvars.name: RECIP ENG CYLINDER HEALTH
units: Index high 16 bits is engine number

units: Set to 1 (TRUE) if the indexed engine (see note) is detonating.

units: FALSE) for the indexed engine (see note).

simvars.name: RECIP ENG EMERGENCY BOOST ELAPSED TIME
units: The elapsed time that emergency boost has been active on the indexed engine (see note). The timer will start when boost is first activated. IMPORTANT! This timer does not reset. So if you set your time limit in the engines.cfg file to 315s and you spend 2 minutes with boost active

then engage boost again for 2 minutes

simvars.name: RECIP ENG ENGINE MASTER SWITCH
units: Whether or not the Engine Master switch is active on an indexed engine (see note).

units: Fuel tank selected for the indexed engine (see note). See Fuel Tank Selection for a list of values.

units: The maximum quantity of nitrous permitted per indexed engine (see note).

units: Design decision altitude above mean sea level

units: Design decision height. This can be set for the aircraft in the FLT file using the DecisionHeight parameter. If not set it will default to 200.

units: This design constant represents the optimal altitude the aircraft should maintain when in cruise. It is derived from the cruise_alt setting in the section of the flightmodel.cfg. Default is 1500ft.

simvars.name: DESIGN SPAWN ALTITUDE CRUISE
units: This design constant represents the spawn altitude for the aircraft when spawning in cruise. It is derived from the spawn_cruise_altitude setting in the section of the flightmodel.cfg. Default is 1500ft.

simvars.name: DESIGN SPAWN ALTITUDE DESCENT
units: This design constant represents the spawn altitude for the aircraft when spawning in descent. It is derived from the spawn_descent_altitude setting in the section of the flightmodel.cfg. Default is 500ft.

simvars.name: DESIGN SPEED CLIMB
units: This design constant represents the optimal climb speed for the aircraft. It is derived from the climb_speed setting in the section of the flightmodel.cfg. Default value is -1.

simvars.name: DESIGN SPEED MIN ROTATION
units: This design constant represents the minimum speed required for aircraft rotation. It is derived from the rotation_speed_min setting in the section of the flightmodel.cfg. Default value is -1.

simvars.name: DESIGN SPEED VC
units: This design constant represents the aircraft ideal cruising speed. It is derived from the cruise_speed setting in the section of the flightmodel.cfg. The default value is computed an internal function that uses the estimated cruise altitude and estimated cruise percent power
the wing area and some drag parameters. Normally this value is set in the CFG file and the default value is never used.

simvars.name: DESIGN SPEED VS0
units: This design constant represents the the stall speed when flaps are fully extended. It is derived from the full_flaps_stall_speed setting in the section of the flightmodel.cfg. Default value is 0.8 x VS.

simvars.name: DESIGN SPEED VS1
units: This design constant represents the stall speed when flaps are fully retracted. It is derived from the flaps_up_stall_speed setting in the section of the flightmodel.cfg. Default value is 0.

simvars.name: DESIGN TAKEOFF SPEED
units: This design constant represents the aircraft ideal takoff speed. It is derived from the takeoff_speed setting in the section of the flightmodel.cfg.

simvars.name: G LIMITER SETTING
units: This returns the setting of the G-limiter

simvars.name: INCIDENCE ALPHA

simvars.name: TYPICAL DESCENT RATE

simvars.name: ZERO LIFT ALPHA

simvars.name: FUELSYSTEM LINE FUEL LEVEL
units: The level of fuel in the indexed line in Gallons. The name is the one defined by the Line.N parameter.

simvars.name: FUELSYSTEM LINE FUEL PRESSURE
units: The pressure in the indexed fuel line

simvars.name: FUELSYSTEM PUMP ACTIVE

simvars.name: FUELSYSTEM PUMP SWITCH

simvars.name: FUELSYSTEM TANK CAPACITY
units: Total capacity of the indexed fuel tank. The name is the one defined by the Tank.N parameter.

simvars.name: FUELSYSTEM TANK USABLE CAPACITY

simvars.name: FUELSYSTEM TANK TOTAL QUANTITY

simvars.name: FUELSYSTEM TANK WEIGHT

the index value will be one of the Fuel Tank Selection indices.

simvars.name: FUELSYSTEM VALVE SWITCH

simvars.name: FUEL TANK EXTERNAL1 LEVEL FUEL TANK EXTERNAL2 LEVEL

simvars.name: FUEL TANK EXTERNAL1 QUANTITY FUEL TANK EXTERNAL2 QUANTITY

units: Current quantity in volume of the left tip tank.

simvars.name: FUEL TANK RIGHT AUX LEVEL
units: Percent of maximum capacity of the right auxiliary tank.

simvars.name: FUEL TANK RIGHT AUX QUANTITY

simvars.name: FUEL TANK RIGHT MAIN CAPACITY
units: Maximum capacity in volume of the right main tank.

simvars.name: FUEL TANK RIGHT MAIN LEVEL
units: Percent of maximum capacity of the right main tank.

simvars.name: FUEL TANK RIGHT MAIN QUANTITY
units: Current quantity in volume of the right main tank.

simvars.name: FUEL TANK RIGHT TIP CAPACITY
units: Maximum capacity in volume of the right tip tank.

simvars.name: FUEL TANK RIGHT TIP LEVEL
units: Percent of maximum capacity of the right tip tank.

units: Current quantity in volume of the right tip tank.

simvars.name: FUEL TANK SELECTOR
units: Which tank the indexed selector is set to. The index is the selector to check (from 1 to 4)
and the return value will be the Fuel Tank Selection index. NOTE: This SimVar is only valid for the legacy setup.

simvars.name: CONTRAILS CONDITIONS MET
units: True if the aircraft has met the conditions required to spawn the contrail VFX.

simvars.name: COVER ON
units: Whether the indexed aircraft part has the covers on (1
false). The index can be one of the following to define the part being checked: 0 - Chocks 1 - Engines 2 - Pitot 3 - StaticPorts 4 - Rotors 5 - LandingGear 6 - Propellers

simvars.name: IS USER SIM
units: Is this the user loaded aircraft.

simvars.name: ON ANY RUNWAY
units: Whether or not the plane is currently on a runway.

simvars.name: PLANE IN PARKING STATE
units: Whether or not the plane is currently parked (true) or not (false).

simvars.name: SURFACE CONDITION
units: The state of the surface directly under the aircraft. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position
regardless of where the camera is

simvars.name: SURFACE INFO VALID
units: True indicates that the SURFACE CONDITION return value is meaningful.

simvars.name: SURFACE TYPE
units: The type of surface under the aircraft. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position
regardless of where the camera is

simvars.name: STRUCTURAL ICE PCT
units: Amount of ice on aircraft structure. 100 is fully iced.

simvars.name: WINDSHIELD RAIN EFFECT AVAILABLE
units: Is visual effect available on this aircraft.

simvars.name: ACCELERATION BODY X
simvars.description: Acceleration relative to aircraft X axis, in east/west direction.

simvars.name: ACCELERATION BODY Y
simvars.description: Acceleration relative to aircraft Y axis, in vertical direction.

simvars.name: ACCELERATION BODY Z
simvars.description: Acceleration relative to aircraft Z axis, in north/south direction.

simvars.name: ACCELERATION WORLD X
simvars.description: Acceleration relative to the earth X axis, in east/west direction.

simvars.name: ACCELERATION WORLD Y
simvars.description: Acceleration relative to the earth Y axis, in vertical direction.

simvars.name: ACCELERATION WORLD Z
simvars.description: Acceleration relative to the earth Z axis, in north/south direction.

simvars.name: AIRCRAFT AGL
simvars.description: The altitude of the aircraft above the surface of the world terrain.

simvars.name: AIRCRAFT ALTITUDE ABOVE OBSTACLES
simvars.description: The altitude of the aircraft above the surface of the world terrain, including any obstacles like buildings.

simvars.name: SURFACE RELATIVE GROUND SPEED
simvars.description: The speed of the aircraft relative to the speed of the first surface directly underneath it. Use this to retrieve, for example, an aircraft's taxiing speed while it is moving on a moving carrier. It also applies to airborne aircraft, for example when a helicopter is successfully hovering above a moving ship, this value should be zero. The returned value will be the same as GROUND VELOCITY if the first surface beneath it is not moving.

simvars.name: GROUND VELOCITY
simvars.description: Speed relative to the earths surface. NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all far aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: PLANE ALT ABOVE GROUND
simvars.description: Altitude above the surface of the world, including obstacles like buildings.

simvars.name: PLANE ALT ABOVE GROUND MINUS CG
simvars.description: Altitude above the surface, including obstacles like buildings, minus CG.

simvars.name: PLANE BANK DEGREES
simvars.description: Bank angle, although the name mentions degrees the units used are radians.

simvars.name: PLANE HEADING DEGREES GYRO
simvars.description: Heading indicator taken from the aircraft gyro.

simvars.name: PLANE HEADING DEGREES MAGNETIC
simvars.description: Heading relative to magnetic north - although the name mentions degrees the units used are radians.

simvars.name: PLANE HEADING DEGREES TRUE
simvars.description: Heading relative to true north - although the name mentions degrees the units used are radians.

simvars.name: PLANE LATITUDE
simvars.description: Latitude of aircraft, North is positive, South negative.

simvars.name: PLANE LONGITUDE
simvars.description: Longitude of aircraft, East is positive, West negative.

simvars.name: PLANE PITCH DEGREES
simvars.description: Pitch angle, although the name mentions degrees the units used are radians.

simvars.name: PLANE TOUCHDOWN BANK DEGREES
simvars.description: This float represents the bank of the player's plane from the last touchdown.

simvars.name: PLANE TOUCHDOWN HEADING DEGREES MAGNETIC
simvars.description: This float represents the magnetic heading of the player's plane from the last touchdown.

simvars.name: PLANE TOUCHDOWN HEADING DEGREES TRUE
simvars.description: This float represents the true heading of the player's plane from the last touchdown.

simvars.name: PLANE TOUCHDOWN LATITUDE
simvars.description: This float represents the plane latitude for the last touchdown.

simvars.name: PLANE TOUCHDOWN LONGITUDE
simvars.description: This float represents the plane longitude for the last touchdown.

simvars.name: PLANE TOUCHDOWN NORMAL VELOCITY
simvars.description: This float represents the player's plane speed according to ground normal from the last touchdown.

simvars.name: PLANE TOUCHDOWN PITCH DEGREES
simvars.description: This float represents the pitch of the player's plane from the last touchdown.

simvars.name: RELATIVE WIND VELOCITY BODY X
simvars.description: Lateral (X axis) speed relative to wind.

simvars.name: RELATIVE WIND VELOCITY BODY Y
simvars.description: Vertical (Y axis) speed relative to wind.

simvars.name: RELATIVE WIND VELOCITY BODY Z
simvars.description: Longitudinal (Z axis) speed relative to wind.

simvars.name: ROTATION ACCELERATION BODY X
simvars.description: Rotation acceleration relative to aircraft X axis.

simvars.name: ROTATION ACCELERATION BODY Y
simvars.description: Rotation acceleration relative to aircraft Y axis.

simvars.name: ROTATION ACCELERATION BODY Z
simvars.description: Rotation acceleration relative to aircraft Z axis.

simvars.name: ROTATION VELOCITY BODY X
simvars.description: Rotation velocity relative to aircraft X axis.

simvars.name: ROTATION VELOCITY BODY Y
simvars.description: Rotation velocity relative to aircraft Y axis.

simvars.name: ROTATION VELOCITY BODY Z
simvars.description: Rotation velocity relative to aircraft Z axis.

simvars.name: SLOPE TO ATC RUNWAY
simvars.description: The slope between the plane and the expected landing position of the runway. Returns 0 if no runway is assigned.

simvars.name: VELOCITY BODY X
simvars.description: True lateral speed, relative to aircraft X axis.

simvars.name: VELOCITY BODY Y
simvars.description: True vertical speed, relative to aircraft Y axis.

simvars.name: VELOCITY BODY Z
simvars.description: True longitudinal speed, relative to aircraft Z axis. Note that this is TAS not IAS, so altitude will influence the value.

simvars.name: VERTICAL SPEED
simvars.description: The current indicated vertical speed for the aircraft.

simvars.name: WARNING FUEL
simvars.description: This is the current state of the fuel warning, either on (true) or off (false).

simvars.name: WARNING FUEL LEFT
simvars.description: This is the current state of the left fuel tank warning, either on (true) or off (false).

simvars.name: WARNING FUEL RIGHT
simvars.description: This is the current state of the right fuel tank warning, either on (true) or off (false).

simvars.name: WARNING LOW HEIGHT
simvars.description: This is the current state of the low height warning, either on (true) or off (false).

simvars.name: WARNING OIL PRESSURE
simvars.description: This is the current state of the oil pressure warning, either on (true) or off (false).

simvars.name: WARNING VACUUM
simvars.description: This is the current state of the vacuum system warning, either on (true) or off (false).

simvars.name: WARNING VACUUM LEFT
simvars.description: This is the current state of the left vacuum system warning, either on (true) or off (false).

simvars.name: WARNING VACUUM RIGHT
simvars.description: This is the current state of the right vacuum system warning, either on (true) or off (false).

simvars.name: WARNING VOLTAGE
simvars.description: This is the current state of the electrical system voltage warning, either on (true) or off (false).

simvars.name: WEAR AND TEAR CHECK PROGRESSION
units: This SimVar is only valid during the pre-flight inspection phase of a flight

it is used to get (or set) the timer used for the inspection interaction (the circular progress bar) with a particular component. The component is identified by the given component ID/name and index. See the Wear And Tear Component IDs section for a full list of component names/IDs.

simvars.name: WEAR AND TEAR EXPOSED PARTS LEVEL
units: This SimVar returns the average wear and tear level of the exposed parts of the aircraft. The SimVar does not take any ID or index
as it is based on an internal calculation which takes data from multiple different sources
etc... The SimVar returns a value between 0 and 1 where a 1 means that the aircraft is fully functional and undamaged
and a value of 0 means that the aircraft is seriously damaged and potentially unflyable.

simvars.name: WEAR AND TEAR EXPOSED PARTS LOWEST LEVEL
units: This SimVar returns the lowest wear and tear level of the exposed parts of the aircraft. The SimVar does not take any ID or index
as it is based on an internal calculation which takes data from multiple different sources
etc... The SimVar returns a value between 0 and 1 where a 1 means that the aircraft is fully functional and undamaged
and a value of 0 means that the aircraft is seriously damaged and potentially unflyable.

simvars.name: WEAR AND TEAR IS FAILED
units: This SimVar will return TRUE (1) if the given component ID/name has failed completely
ie: it's "health" has fallen to zero and the component is considered by the simulation as "broken". If the component is still functioning
regardless of how "weak" it may be
then this will return FALSE (1). See the Wear And Tear Component IDs section for a full list of component names/IDs.

simvars.name: WEAR AND TEAR IS WEAK
units: This SimVar will return TRUE (1) if the given component ID/name is considered as being "weak"
ie: it's "health" has fallen to a point where it could fail or break
and the compònent may have reduced functionality. If the component is not considered as "weak" (even if its wear and tear value is less than 1)
then this will return FALSE (1). See the Wear And Tear Component IDs section for a full list of component names/IDs.

simvars.name: WEAR AND TEAR LEVEL
units: This SimVar returns the current wear and tear level of the component or system being referenced
where a value of 1 is a fully functional and undamaged component
and a value of 0 means that the component has failed. The SimVar requires an ID value or name

and may also use an additional index value to tell the simulation exactly which one of the components of the given type you are targeting. See the Wear And Tear Component IDs section for a full list of component names/IDs.

simvars.name: WEAR AND TEAR WEAK VALUE
units: This SimVar returns the current "weakness" level of the component or system being referenced
where a value of 1 is a fully functional (but not necessarily undamaged) component
and a value of 0 means that the component has failed. If this value is less than 1
then the component will experience reduced functionality and may also be more prone to failure and breaking. The SimVar requires an ID value or name

and may also use an additional index value to tell the simulation exactly which one of the components of the given type you are targeting. See the Wear And Tear Component IDs section for a full list of component names/IDs.

simvars.name: EYEPOINT POSITION
simvars.description: The eyepoint position relative to the reference datum position for the aircraft.

simvars.name: STRUC AIRSPEED HOLD PID CONSTS
simvars.description: Returns the various airspeed PID constants. This is generally only used for AI controlled aircraft and boats, although it may be useful when working with RTCs and the user aircraft. Not used in the simulation.

simvars.name: STRUC HEADING HOLD PID CONSTS
simvars.description: Returns the various airspeed PID constants. This is generally only used for AI controlled aircraft and boats, although it may be useful when working with RTCs and the user aircraft. Not used in the simulation.

simvars.name: STRUCT BODY ROTATION ACCELERATION
simvars.description: The body rotation acceleration. Not used in the simulation.

simvars.name: STRUCT ENGINE POSITION
simvars.description: The position of the indexed engine relative to the Datum Reference Point for the aircraft.

simvars.name: STRUCT EYEPOINT DYNAMIC ANGLE
simvars.description: The angle of the eyepoint view. Zero, zero, zero is straight ahead.

simvars.name: STRUCT EYEPOINT DYNAMIC OFFSET
simvars.description: A variable offset away from the EYEPOINT POSITION.

simvars.name: STRUCT LATLONALT
simvars.description: Returns the latitude, longitude and altitude of the user aircraft.

simvars.name: STRUCT LATLONALTPBH
simvars.description: Returns the latitude, longitude, altitude, pitch, bank and heading of the user aircraft.
units: Returns a struct with 6 values: lat

simvars.name: AIRCRAFT CATEGORY
simvars.description: Returns the category of the aircraft as defined by the ui_typerole parameter.

simvars.name: AIRCRAFT OBJECT CLASS
simvars.description: Returns the aircraft class. This will either be a string interpreted from the object_class parameter, or an inferred value based on the AIRCRAFT CATEGORY if the class parameter is missing.
units: String: AIRPLANE HELICOPTER GLIDER LIGHTERTHANAIR ("Ballon" or "Airship" object_class) OTHER (all other object_class)

simvars.name: AIRCRAFT WIND X
simvars.description: Wind component in aircraft lateral (X) axis.

simvars.name: AIRCRAFT WIND Y
simvars.description: Wind component in aircraft vertical (Y) axis.

simvars.name: AIRCRAFT WIND Z
simvars.description: Wind component in aircraft longitudinal (Z) axis.

simvars.name: AIRSPEED INDICATED THEORETICAL
simvars.description: The theoretical indicated airspeed, ignoring things like the pitot cover and icing.

simvars.name: AIRSPEED SELECT INDICATED OR TRUE
simvars.description: The airspeed, whether true or indicated airspeed has been selected.

simvars.name: AIRSPEED TRUE RAW
simvars.description: Equivalent to AIRSPEED TRUE, but does not account for wind when used to Set Airspeed value

simvars.name: TOTAL VELOCITY
simvars.description: Velocity regardless of direction. For example, if a helicopter is ascending vertically at 100 fps, getting this variable will return 100.

simvars.name: WINDSHIELD WIND VELOCITY
simvars.description: Longitudinal speed of wind on the "windshield". The testing location is not actually the windshield and is instead based on the Physics Groups setup for the aircraft.

simvars.name: STANDARD ATM TEMPERATURE
simvars.description: Outside temperature on the standard ATM scale.

simvars.name: TOTAL AIR TEMPERATURE
simvars.description: Total air temperature is the air temperature at the front of the aircraft where the ram pressure from the speed of the aircraft is taken into account.

simvars.name: ORNITHOPTER DIVE MODE ENABLED
units: Returns whether the ornithopter dive mode is enabled (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

simvars.name: ORNITHOPTER GLIDE MODE ENABLED
units: Returns whether the ornithopter glide mode is enabled (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

simvars.name: ORNITHOPTER WINGS BRAKE ENABLED
units: Returns whether the ornithopter wing brake is enabled (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

simvars.name: ORNITHOPTER WINGS BRAKE ACTIVE
units: Returns whether the ornithopter wing brake is active (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

simvars.name: ORNITHOPTER WING HORIZONTAL TILT
units: The horizontal tilt of the indexed wing expressed as a value between 0 and 1.

simvars.name: ORNITHOPTER WING PITCH
units: The pitch of the indexed wing expressed as a value between 0 and 1.

simvars.name: ORNITHOPTER WING VERTICAL TILT
units: The vertical tilt of the indexed wing expressed as a value between 0 and 1.

simvars.name: ORNITHOPTER WINGS BLUR
units: The current amount of blur applied to the animation of the ornithopter wings when flapping
expressed as a value between 0 (none) and 1 (maximum).

simvars.name: ORNITHOPTER WINGS CLUTCH STATE
units: The current progress of engaging/disengaging the clutch on the wings when entering or leaving glide mode
expressed as a value between 0 and 1.

simvars.name: ORNITHOPTER WINGS FOLDING OPERATION ID
units: Returns a value that defines the current folding operation of the wings
where: 0 - stand by 1 - parking (slow mode) 2 - setting up (slow mode) 3 - folding for diving (fast mode) 4 - unfolding from a dive (fast mode)

simvars.name: ORNITHOPTER WORLD LIFT
units: Returns the current total lift of the ornithopter.

simvars.name: ADF AVAILABLE
units: True if indexed ADF is available

simvars.name: ADF LATLONALT
units: longitude and altitude of the station the radio equipment is currently tuned to
or zeros if the radio is not tuned to any ADF station. Index of 1 or 2 for ADF 1 and ADF 2.

simvars.name: ADF RADIAL MAG
units: Returns the magnetic bearing to the currently tuned ADF transmitter.

simvars.name: ADF SOUND
units: ADF audio flag. Index of 0 or 1.

simvars.name: ADF STANDBY AVAILABLE
units: True if ADF Standby is available

simvars.name: ADF VOLUME
units: Returns the volume of the ADF

simvars.name: ATC AIRLINE
simvars.description: The name of the Airline used by ATC, as a string with a maximum length of 50 characters.

simvars.name: ATC AIRPORT IS TOWERED
simvars.description: If the airport is controlled, this boolean is true.

simvars.name: ATC ARRIVAL AIRPORT HAS ATIS
simvars.description: If the arrival airport has ATIS, this boolean is true.

simvars.name: ATC ARRIVAL AIRPORT IS TOWERED
simvars.description: If the arrival airport is controlled, this boolean is true.

simvars.name: ATC ASSIGNED ALTITUDE
simvars.description: The altitude assigned by the ATC. Returns -1 if no altitude is assigned.

simvars.name: ATC CLEARED IFR
simvars.description: Returns whether or not the user has filed an IFR flightplan that has been cleared by the sim ATC

simvars.name: ATC CLEARED LANDING
simvars.description: Whether the ATC has cleared the plane for landing.

simvars.name: ATC CLEARED OVERFLIGHT CTR
simvars.description: Whether the ATC has cleared the plane for overflight of CTR area.

simvars.name: ATC CLEARED TAKEOFF
simvars.description: Whether the ATC has cleared the plane for takeoff.

simvars.name: ATC CLEARED TAXI
simvars.description: Whether the ATC has cleared the plane for taxi.

simvars.name: ATC CURRENT WAYPOINT ALTITUDE
simvars.description: Returns the target altitude for the current ATC flightplan waypoint.

simvars.name: ATC DEPARTURE AIRPORT IS TOWERED
simvars.description: If the departure airport is controlled, this boolean is true.

simvars.name: ATC DESIGNATED GATE ARRIVAL
simvars.description: The name of the gate assigned by the ATC for arrival. Returns "None" if no gate is assigned.

simvars.name: ATC DESIGNATED GATE DEPARTURE
simvars.description: The name of the gate assigned by the ATC for departure. Returns "None" if no gate is assigned.,

simvars.name: ATC DESIGNATED RUNWAY LANDING
simvars.description: The name of the runway assigned by the ATC for landing. Returns "None" if no runway is assigned.

simvars.name: ATC DESIGNATED RUNWAY TAKEOFF
simvars.description: The name of the runway assigned by the ATC for takeoff. Returns "None" if no runway is assigned.

simvars.name: ATC FIRST VFR ARRIVAL PATTERN WAYPOINT NAME
simvars.description: The name of the first waypoint in VFR arrival procedure. Returns "None" if no waypoint is assigned.

simvars.name: ATC FLIGHTPLAN DIFF ALT
simvars.description: Altitude between the position of the aircraft and his closest waypoints in the flightplan.

simvars.name: ATC FLIGHTPLAN DIFF DISTANCE
simvars.description: Returns the lateral distance the user's plane is from the ATC flight plan track.

simvars.name: ATC FLIGHTPLAN DIFF HEADING
simvars.description: Heading between the position of the aircraft and his closest waypoints in the flightplan.

simvars.name: ATC FP ARRIVAL TRAFFIC PATTERN IS LEFTHANDED
simvars.description: If TRUE (1) then the traffic pattern is left handed at arrival, otherwise it is right handed.

simvars.name: ATC FP DEPARTURE TRAFFIC PATTERN IS LEFTHANDED
simvars.description: If TRUE (1) then the traffic pattern is left handed at departure, otherwise it is right handed.

simvars.name: ATC FLIGHT NUMBER
simvars.description: Flight Number used by ATC, as a string with a maximum number of 6 characters.

simvars.name: ATC HEAVY
simvars.description: Is this aircraft recognized by ATC as heavy.

simvars.name: ATC ID
simvars.description: ID used by ATC, as a string with a maximum number of 10 characters.

simvars.name: ATC IFR FP TO REQUEST
simvars.description: Returns true if the user has a valid IFR flight plan they can as for clearance for with ATC at the airport they are currently at.

simvars.name: ATC MISSION FP IFR
simvars.description: Returns true if the mission requires an IFR flight plan.

simvars.name: ATC MODEL
simvars.description: Model used by ATC, as a string with a maximum number of 128 characters.

simvars.name: ATC NAME
simvars.description: Aircraft name used by ATC, as a string with a maximum number of 50 characters.

simvars.name: ATC NEXT WAYPOINT ALTITUDE
simvars.description: This will indicate the altitude of the next waypoint of the flightpath.

simvars.name: ATC NEXT WAYPOINT NAME
simvars.description: The name of the next waypoint assigned by the ATC. Returns "None" if no waypoint is assigned.

simvars.name: ATC ON PARKING SPOT
simvars.description: Is ATC aircraft on parking spot.

simvars.name: ATC OVERFLYING AIRPORT UNANNOUNCED
simvars.description: Is ATC aircraft overflying an airport without announcing themselves.

simvars.name: ATC PREVIOUS WAYPOINT ALTITUDE
simvars.description: Returns the target altitude for the previous ATC flightplan waypoint.

simvars.name: ATC RUNWAY AIRPORT NAME
simvars.description: The name of the airport of the runway assigned by the ATC. Returns "" if no runway is assigned.

simvars.description: This float represents the distance between the player's plane and the center of the runway selected by the ATC.

simvars.name: ATC RUNWAY END DISTANCE
simvars.description: This is a float corresponding to the horizontal distance between the player's plane and the end of the runway selected by the ATC.

simvars.name: ATC RUNWAY HEADING DEGREES TRUE
simvars.description: This float represents the true heading of the runway selected by the ATC.

simvars.name: ATC RUNWAY LENGTH
simvars.description: The length of the runway assigned by the ATC. Returns -1 if no runway is assigned.

simvars.name: ATC RUNWAY RELATIVE POSITION X
simvars.description: This is a float corresponding to the player's main gear relative X (transverse) position on the runway selected by the ATC.

simvars.name: ATC RUNWAY RELATIVE POSITION Y
simvars.description: This is a float corresponding to the player's main gear relative Y (height) position on the runway selected by the ATC.

simvars.name: ATC RUNWAY RELATIVE POSITION Z
simvars.description: This is a float corresponding to the player's main gear relative Z (longitudinal) position on the runway selected by the ATC.

simvars.name: ATC RUNWAY SELECTED
simvars.description: This is a boolean corresponding to whether or not the ATC has pre-selected a runway for the player's plane. If this is false, every other ATC RUNWAY * SimVar will return default values.

simvars.name: ATC RUNWAY START DISTANCE
simvars.description: This is a float corresponding to the horizontal distance between the player's plane and the start of the runway selected by the ATC.

simvars.name: ATC RUNWAY TDPOINT RELATIVE POSITION X
simvars.description: This float represents the player's main gear relative X (transverse) position according to the aiming point of the runway selected by the ATC.

simvars.name: ATC RUNWAY TDPOINT RELATIVE POSITION Y
simvars.description: This float represents the player's main gear relative Y (height) position according to the aiming point of the runway selected by the ATC.

simvars.name: ATC RUNWAY TDPOINT RELATIVE POSITION Z
simvars.description: This float represents the player's main relative Z (longitudinal) position according to the aiming point of the runway selected by the ATC.

simvars.name: ATC RUNWAY WIDTH
simvars.description: The width of the runway assigned by the ATC. Returns -1 if no runway is assigned.

simvars.name: ATC SUGGESTED MIN RWY LANDING

simvars.name: ATC SUGGESTED MIN RWY TAKEOFF

simvars.name: ATC TAXIPATH DISTANCE

simvars.name: FLARM THREAT DATA
simvars.description: The FLARM threat aircraft data structure, which contains data about the perceived threat, returned as a struct. Struct member variables are as follows: id (U62): the network ID of the intruding plane so that they are remembered in order to compute their trajectory. bearing (FLOAT64): The threat bearing, in degrees (this is bearing from track axis and not bearing from the airplane axis). heading (FLOAT64): The threat heading. distance (FLOAT64): The distance between the aircraft and the threat, in meters. verticalBearing (FLOAT64): The vertical bearing between the aircraft and the threat, in degrees. relativeAltitude (FLOAT64): The relative altitude of the threat to the aircraft, in meters. timeToCollision (FLOAT64): The estimated time to a collision, in seconds.

simvars.name: GPS CDI NEEDLE

simvars.name: GPS ETE
simvars.description: Estimated time en route to destination.

simvars.name: GPS FLIGHTPLAN TOTAL DISTANCE
simvars.description: This is the complete flightplan length from start to end. Essentially the cumulative length of all the flight plan legs added together.

generally used only when working with in-sim panels and is used to go to the showcase cameras
defaulting to the last selected camera within this section (Drone

simvars.name: CAMERA SUBSTATE
units: This variable can be used to get or set the camera "sub-state". The options here are generally only required when working with the in-sim panel UI. Note that the "locked" and "unlocked" state will be changed automatically if the following SimVars have their values changed: COCKPIT CAMERA HEADLOOK

simvars.name: CAMERA VIEW TYPE AND INDEX
units: With this you can get or set both the type of view for the current camera
as well as the option index

which will be between 0 and the maximum index value (as retrieved using the CAMERA VIEW TYPE AND INDEX MAX SimVar). Supplying an index of 0 to the SimVar will get/set the type (from the selection of enum values listed)
and using an index of 1 will get/set the option index
which is an integer value. Please see the Notes On View Types And Indices section below for more information.

simvars.name: CAMERA VIEW TYPE AND INDEX MAX
units: This variable can get the number of option indices related to a specific camera view type. The index value supplied to the SimVar should be one of the camera view type Enum values (see CAMERA VIEW TYPE AND INDEX)
and the SimVar will return the number of options available for that camera type (counting from 1
so - for example - if the camera view type is "Quickview" and has 8 quickview settings
then CAMERA VIEW TYPE AND INDEX MAX:4 will return 8). Note that this value can be set after a flight has started

but it will have no effect since the number of camera options is initilaised once only and not updated (and the simulation may overwrite the value again even after setting it). Please see the Notes On View Types And Indices section below for more information.

simvars.name: DIRECTORS CUT CAMERA PITCH
units: Sets the pitch of the Director's Cut camera gimbal.

simvars.name: DIRECTORS CUT CAMERA YAW
units: Sets the yaw of the Director's Cut camera gimbal.

simvars.name: GAMEPLAY CAMERA FOCUS
units: This gets/sets the focus for the camera zoom
or auto. The setting affects both the Cockpit and the External (Chase) cameras. The following SimVars can be used to get/set the level of zoom: COCKPIT CAMERA ZOOM or CHASE_CAMERA_ZOOM.

simvars.name: IS CAMERA LOCKED
units: This will return whether the camera is locked (1

simvars.name: IS CAMERA RAY INTERSECT WITH NODE
units: This SimVar is used to check for a collision along a ray from the center of the user FOV and a model node. The available nodes that can be checked using this SimVar must be previously defined in the [CAMERA_RAY_NODE_COLLISION] of the cameras.cfg file. The SimVar requires a node index value between 1 and 10
corresponding to the node defined in the CFG file
and the SimVar will return 1 (TRUE) if there is a collision along the camera ray or 0 (FALSE) otherwise. You may also supply an index of 0 to perform a collision check for all defined nodes
in which case the SimVar will return 1 (TRUE) if there is a collision between the ray and any of the defined nodes. Supplying an index outside of the range of 1 to 10
or supplying an index for which no node has been defined

simvars.name: CHASE CAMERA HEADLOOK
simvars.description: This is used to get/set the look state of the chase (external) camera. Note that this value will also affect the CAMERA SUBSTATE value, when the CAMERA STATE is set to 3 (External/Chase).

simvars.name: CHASE CAMERA MOMENTUM
simvars.description: Sets/gets the momentum modifier of the chase (external) camera, which is controls how fast/slow the camera will stop moving when no longer being moved by the user. Default is 50%.

simvars.name: CHASE CAMERA SPEED
simvars.description: Sets/gets the translation speed modifier of the chase (external) camara, as a percentage. Default is 50%.

simvars.name: CHASE CAMERA ZOOM
simvars.description: Sets/gets the zoom/FOV modifier for the chase (external) camera. Note that when setting this value, it will affect the camera regardless of whether the GAMEPLAY_CAMERA_FOCUS is set to manual or automatic. Default is 50%.

simvars.name: CHASE CAMERA ZOOM SPEED
simvars.description: Sets/gets the speed modifier for when the zoom/FOV chase (external) camera changes zoom/FOV levels. Default is 50%.

simvars.name: CAMERA ACTION COCKPIT VIEW RESET
simvars.description: This can be used to reset the cockpit camera when the CAMERA STATE is set to 2 (Cockpit). Essentially the same as the user pressing the default reset keys CTRL + Space.

simvars.name: CAMERA ACTION COCKPIT VIEW SAVE
simvars.description: This can be used to save a cockpit camera when the CAMERA STATE is set to 2 (Cockpit). The index value given is the save "slot" that will be used, from 0 to 9. Essentially this is the same as the user pressing the default save keys CTRL + Alt + 0-9.

simvars.name: COCKPIT CAMERA HEADLOOK
simvars.description: This is used to get/set the look state of the cockpit camera. Note that this value will also affect the CAMERA SUBSTATE value, when the CAMERA STATE is set to 2 (Cockpit).

simvars.name: COCKPIT CAMERA HEIGHT
simvars.description: This can be used to get/set the cockpit camera height modifier expressed as a percentage. Default is 50%.

simvars.name: COCKPIT CAMERA INSTRUMENT AUTOSELECT
simvars.description: This can be used to get or set the autoselect option for the cockpit camera when viewing the instruments (ie: the CAMERA SUBSTATE is 5). When enabled the camera will move automatically if the player mouse reaches the edge of the screen and there are instrument panels available on that side.

simvars.name: COCKPIT CAMERA MOMENTUM
simvars.description: Sets/gets the momentum modifier of the cockpit camera, which is controls how fast/slow the camera will stop moving when no longer being moved by the user. Default is 50%.

simvars.name: COCKPIT CAMERA SIDE
simvars.description: Not currently used in the simulation.

simvars.name: COCKPIT CAMERA SPEED
simvars.description: Sets/gets the translation speed modifier of the cockpit camara, as a percentage. Default is 50%.

simvars.name: COCKPIT CAMERA UPPER POSITION
simvars.description: Sets/gets the current "upper position" cockpit camera toggle. When 1 (TRUE), the camera is is in the upper position, and when 0 (FALSE) it is in the default position.

simvars.name: COCKPIT CAMERA ZOOM
simvars.description: Sets/gets the zoom/FOV modifier for the cockpit camera. Note that when setting this value, it will affect the camera regardless of whether the GAMEPLAY_CAMERA_FOCUS is set to manual or automatic. Default is 50%.

simvars.name: COCKPIT CAMERA ZOOM SPEED
simvars.description: Sets/gets the speed modifier for when the zoom/FOV cockpit camera changes zoom/FOV levels. Default is 50%.

simvars.name: DRONE CAMERA FOCUS
simvars.description: Sets/gets the focus modifier for the drone camera. Default is 50%, and a lower value will set the drone focus to things in the foreground and a higher level will set the drone focus to things in the background. Note that this is only taken into account when the DRONE CAMERA FOCUS MODE is set to 3 (manual).

simvars.name: DRONE CAMERA FOCUS MODE
simvars.description: Sets/gets the current drone focus mode. When set to 3 (manual), the focus position will be based on the DRONE CAMERA FOCUS value.

simvars.name: DRONE CAMERA FOLLOW
simvars.description: Sets/gets the whether the drone camera is in follow mode or not.

simvars.name: DRONE CAMERA FOV
simvars.description: Sets/gets the zoom/FOV modifier for the drone camera. Default is 50%.

simvars.name: DRONE CAMERA LOCKED
simvars.description: Sets/gets the whether the drone camera is locked or not.

simvars.name: DRONE CAMERA SPEED ROTATION
simvars.description: Sets/gets the rotation speed modifier of the drone camara, as a percentage. Default is 50%.

simvars.name: DRONE CAMERA SPEED TRAVELLING
simvars.description: Sets/gets the translation speed modifier of the drone camara, as a percentage. Default is 50%.

simvars.name: SMART CAMERA ACTIVE
units: Sets/gets the whether the smart camera is active or not.

simvars.name: SMART CAMERA INFO
units: Gets information on the smartcam system. The index sets what kind of information will be returned (or set): 0 = Gets the number of smartcam targets in the smart camera list 1 = Gets or sets the index of the currently selected smartcam target
counting from 0 (so index 0 is the first target in the list).

simvars.name: SMART CAMERA LIST
units: Retrieves the type of target for the indexed position in the smartcam list
counting from 0 (so index 0 is the first target in the list).

simvars.name: SMART CAMERA LIST DESCRIPTION
units: This returns a localized string that represents the smartcam target specified by the given index. Indices count from 0 so index 0 is the first target in the list.

simvars.name: BALLOON AUTO FILL ACTIVE
units: Sets / returns whether the balloon is creating air inside to emulate fans air flow or not.

simvars.name: BALLOON FILL AMOUNT
units: This is used to get / set the ratio of air within the balloon envelope from 0 (empty) to 1 (full).

simvars.name: BALLOON GAS DENSITY
units: The density of the gas inside the balloon.

simvars.name: BALLOON GAS TEMPERATURE
units: Temperature of the gas inside a balloon.

simvars.name: BALLOON VENT OPEN VALUE
units: This represents how open the "parachute valve" of a hot air balloon is
where 0 is fully closed and 1 is fully open.

simvars.name: BURNER FUEL FLOW RATE
units: The amount of fuel that is flowing through the named Burner expressed in lbs per hour.

simvars.name: BURNER HEATING POWER
units: This is the thermal power of the named (or indexed) Burner expressed in BTU per hour. If a value of 0 is given instead of a name (or index) then the sum total of all burners heating power will be returned.

simvars.name: BURNER PILOT LIGHT ON
units: The named (or indexed) hot air balloon Burner pilot light status
and 1 (TRUE) is on. Note that of the burner is not receiving fuel this SimVar will revert to 0 (FALSE)

simvars.name: BURNER VALVE OPEN VALUE
units: This represents how open the the named (or indexed) burner Valve is
where 0 is fully closed and 1 is fully open.

simvars.name: GROUND ATTACHMENT
units: This toggles the status of the attachment rope. When 1 (true) the balloon has an attachment rope

simvars.name: AIRSHIP COMPARTMENT GAS TYPE
units: Gets the type of gas being used by the named (or indexed) gas compartment.

simvars.name: AIRSHIP COMPARTMENT OVERPRESSURE
units: Gets the over-pressure value of the named (or indexed) gas compartment. Note that this value is commonly expressed using inWG
which is not a supported SimVar unit
therfore some conversion may need done on the value before display/use.

simvars.name: AIRSHIP COMPARTMENT PRESSURE
units: Gets the current pressure value of the named (or indexed) gas compartment. Note that this value is commonly expressed using inWG
which is not a supported SimVar unit
therfore some conversion may need done on the value before display/use.

simvars.name: AIRSHIP COMPARTMENT TEMPERATURE
units: Gets the current temperature value of the named (or indexed) gas compartment.

simvars.name: AIRSHIP COMPARTMENT VOLUME
units: Gets the volume of gas in the named (or indexed) gas compartment.

simvars.name: AIRSHIP COMPARTMENT WEIGHT
units: Gets the weight of gas in the named (or indexed) gas compartment.

simvars.name: AIRSHIP DAMPER STATE
units: Gets or sets the state of the named (or indexed) gas compartment damper. Note that dampers are not defined explicitly
but are added automatically by the simulation
one per-compartment that is of the gas type "Air". Non-air compartments do not have dampers.

simvars.name: AIRSHIP FAN POWER PCT
units: Gets or sets the state of the air intake fan for the named (or indexed) gas compartment. Note that air intake fans are not defined explicitly
but are added automatically by the simulation
one per-compartment that is of the gas type "Air". Non-air compartments do not have air intake fans.

simvars.name: AIRSHIP VALVE STATE
units: Gets or sets the state of the named (or indexed) valve.

simvars.name: MAST TRUCK DEPLOYMENT
units: This toggles the status of the mast truck. When 1 (true) the truck should deploy the mast and other stabilisers
and when 0 (false) it should retract the mast and other stabilisers.

simvars.name: MAST TRUCK EXTENSION
units: This is used to get / set the extension value of the mast from the mast truck (which needs to be deployed first)
where a value of 0 is no extension and a value of 100 is full extension.

simvars.name: BAGGAGELOADER ANGLE CURRENT
simvars.description: Current angle of the baggage loader ramp, relative to the ground.

simvars.name: BAGGAGELOADER ANGLE TARGET
simvars.description: Target angle of the baggage loader ramp, relative to the ground.

simvars.name: BAGGAGELOADER END RAMP Y
simvars.description: "Y" axis position of the end of the baggage loader ramp, relative to the ground.

simvars.name: BAGGAGELOADER END RAMP Z
simvars.description: "Z" axis position of the end of the baggage loader ramp, relative to the ground.

simvars.name: BAGGAGELOADER PIVOT Y
simvars.description: "Y" axis position of the baggage loader ramp pivot, relative to the ground.

simvars.name: BAGGAGELOADER PIVOT Z
simvars.description: "Z" axis position of the baggage loader ramp pivot, relative to the ground.

simvars.name: BOARDINGRAMP ELEVATION CURRENT
simvars.description: The current altitude AGL of the top of the boarding ramp stairs.

simvars.name: BOARDINGRAMP ELEVATION TARGET
simvars.description: The target altitude AGL of the top of the boarding ramp stairs.

simvars.name: BOARDINGRAMP END POSITION Y
simvars.description: The "Y" axis position of the top of the boarding ramp stairs when extended at maximal capacity, relative to the ground.

simvars.name: BOARDINGRAMP END POSITION Z
simvars.description: The "Z" axis position of the top of the boarding ramp stairs when extended at maximal capacity, relative to the ground.

simvars.name: BOARDINGRAMP ORIENTATION CURRENT
simvars.description: The current orientation of the boarding ramp stairs, where 0 is at rest and 1 is suited for boarding.

simvars.name: BOARDINGRAMP ORIENTATION TARGET
simvars.description: The target orientation of of the boarding ramp stairs, where 0 is at rest and 1 is suited for boarding.

simvars.name: BOARDINGRAMP START POSITION Y
simvars.description: The "Y" axis position of the top of the boarding ramp stairs when at minimal extension, relative to the ground.

simvars.name: BOARDINGRAMP START POSITION Z
simvars.description: The "Z" axis position of the top of the boarding ramp stairs when at minimal extension, relative to the ground.

simvars.name: BOARDINGRAMP STRAIGHT POSITION Y
simvars.description: The "Y" axis position of the top of the boarding ramp stairs when extended straight, relative to the ground.

simvars.name: BOARDINGRAMP STRAIGHT POSITION Z
simvars.description: The "Z" axis position of the top of the boarding ramp stairs when extended straight, relative to the ground.

simvars.name: CATERINGTRUCK AIRCRAFT DOOR CONTACT OFFSET Z
simvars.description: The "Z" axis position of the point of contact between the catering truck and the bottom of the aircraft door, relative to the ground.

simvars.name: CATERINGTRUCK ELEVATION CURRENT
simvars.description: The current altitude AGL of the bottom of the catering truck container.

simvars.name: CATERINGTRUCK ELEVATION TARGET
simvars.description: The target altitude AGL of the bottom of the catering truck container.

simvars.name: CATERINGTRUCK OPENING CURRENT
simvars.description: The current state of the catering truck when opening the container and deploying the bridge, where 0 is fully closed and 1 is fully opened and deployed.

simvars.name: CATERINGTRUCK OPENING TARGET
simvars.description: The target state of the catering truck the container is opene and the bridge deployed, where 0 is fully closed and 1 is fully opened and deployed.

simvars.name: FUELTRUCK HOSE DEPLOYED
simvars.description: The current deployment amount of the fuel truck hose. Currently can only be set to 0 (not deployed) and 1 (deployed).

simvars.name: FUELTRUCK HOSE END POSX
simvars.description: The "X" axis position of the end of the fuel truck hose when fully deployed, relative to the ground.

simvars.name: FUELTRUCK HOSE END POSZ
simvars.description: The "Z" axis position of the end of the fuel truck hose when fully deployed, relative to the ground.

simvars.name: FUELTRUCK HOSE END RELATIVE HEADING
simvars.description: The heading of the end of the fuel truck hose, relative to the vehicle heading.

simvars.name: GROUNDPOWERUNIT HOSE DEPLOYED
simvars.description: The current deployment amount of the ground power unit hose. Currently can only be set to 0 (not deployed) and 1 (deployed).

simvars.name: GROUNDPOWERUNIT HOSE END POSX
simvars.description: The "X" axis position of the end of the ground power unit hose when fully deployed, relative to the ground.

simvars.name: GROUNDPOWERUNIT HOSE END POSZ
simvars.description: The "Z" axis position of the end of the ground power unit hose when fully deployed, relative to the ground.

simvars.name: GROUNDPOWERUNIT HOSE END RELATIVE HEADING
simvars.description: The heading of the end of the ground power unit hose, relative to the vehicle heading.

simvars.name: JETWAY HOOD LEFT BEND
simvars.description: The target position for the left bend animation of the jetway hood.

simvars.name: JETWAY HOOD LEFT DEPLOYMENT
simvars.description: The target angle for the left deployment animation of the jetway hood, where 0 is considered vertical.

simvars.name: JETWAY HOOD RIGHT BEND
simvars.description: The target position for the right bend animation of the jetway hood.

simvars.name: JETWAY HOOD RIGHT DEPLOYMENT
simvars.description: The target angle for the right deployment animation of the jetway hood, where 0 is considered vertical.

simvars.name: JETWAY HOOD TOP HORIZONTAL
simvars.description: Target position for the top horizontal animation of the jetway hood. Values can be between -100% and 100%.

simvars.name: JETWAY HOOD TOP VERTICAL
simvars.description: Target position for the top vertical animation of the jetway hood. Values can be between -100% and 100%.

simvars.name: JETWAY MOVING
simvars.description: This will be 1 (TRUE) ID the jetway body is currently moving (it will not include checks on hood animation).

simvars.name: JETWAY WHEEL ORIENTATION CURRENT
simvars.description: The current angle of the jetway wheels.

simvars.name: JETWAY WHEEL ORIENTATION TARGET
simvars.description: The (approximate) target angle for the jetway wheels.

simvars.name: JETWAY WHEEL SPEED
simvars.description: The current speed of the jetway wheels.

simvars.name: MARSHALLER AIRCRAFT DIRECTION PARKINGSPACE
simvars.description: Currently not used in the simulation.

simvars.name: MARSHALLER AIRCRAFT DISTANCE
simvars.description: The distance between the Marshaller and the aircraft.

simvars.name: MARSHALLER AIRCRAFT DISTANCE DIRECTION X PARKINGSPACE
simvars.description: Position on the X axis of the aircraft in the parking space (negative means the aircraft is on the left side and positive the right side).

simvars.name: MARSHALLER AIRCRAFT DISTANCE DIRECTION Z PARKINGSPACE
simvars.description: Position on the Z axis of the aircraft in the parking space (negative means the aircraft is behind the parking space and positive is in front of the parking space).

simvars.name: MARSHALLER AIRCRAFT ENGINE SHUTDOWN
simvars.description: True if the engine(s) of the aircraft is (are) shut down.

simvars.name: MARSHALLER AIRCRAFT HEADING PARKINGSPACE
simvars.description: Angle between the direction of the aircraft and the direction of the parking place.

simvars.name: MARSHALLER AIRCRAFT PROJECTION POINT PARKINGSPACE
simvars.description: Value in Z axis of the projection from the aircraft position following the heading of the aircraft.

simvars.name: PUSHBACK ANGLE
simvars.description: Pushback angle (the heading of the tug).

simvars.name: PUSHBACK ATTACHED
simvars.description: True if this vehicle is attached to an aircraft.

simvars.name: PUSHBACK AVAILABLE
simvars.description: True if a push back is available on the parking space.

simvars.name: PUSHBACK CONTACTX
simvars.description: The towpoint position, relative to the aircrafts datum reference point.

simvars.name: PUSHBACK CONTACTY
simvars.description: Pushback contact position in vertical direction.

simvars.name: PUSHBACK CONTACTZ
simvars.description: Pushback contact position in fore/aft direction.

simvars.name: WAGON BACK LINK LENGTH
simvars.description: The length of the link at the back of the vehicle used to attach a wagon behind.

simvars.name: WAGON BACK LINK ORIENTATION
simvars.description: The current orientation of the link at the back of the vehicle used to attach a wagon behind.

simvars.name: WAGON BACK LINK START POSZ
simvars.description: The "Z" axis position of the start of the link at the back of the vehicle used to attach a wagon behind, relative to the ground.

simvars.name: WAGON FRONT LINK LENGTH
simvars.description: The length of the link at the front of the vehicle used to be attached as wagon.

simvars.name: WAGON FRONT LINK ORIENTATION
simvars.description: The current orientation of the link at the front of the vehicle used to be attached as wagon.

simvars.name: WAGON FRONT LINK START POSZ
simvars.description: The "Z" axis position of the start of the link at the front of the vehicle used to be attached as wagon, relative to the ground.

simvars.name: ANIMATION DELTA TIME
simvars.description: Difference of time between the current frame and the last frame where this SimObject has been animated

simvars.name: ARTIFICIAL GROUND ELEVATION
simvars.description: In case scenery is not loaded for AI planes, this variable can be used to set a default surface elevation.

simvars.name: CRASH FLAG
simvars.description: Flag value that indicates the cause of a crash.
units: Enum: 0:[index] None 2:[index] Mountain 4:[index] General 6:[index] Building 8:[index] Splash 10:[index] Gear up 12:[index] Overstress 14:[index] Building 16:[index] Aircraft 18:[index] Fuel Truck

simvars.name: CRASH SEQUENCE
simvars.description: The state of the crash event sequence.
units: Enum: 0:[index] off 1:[index] complete 3:[index] reset 4:[index] pause 11:[index] start

simvars.name: GROUND ALTITUDE
simvars.description: Altitude of surface. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position, regardless of where the camera is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: HAND ANIM STATE
simvars.description: What frame of the hand is currently used.
units: Enum: 0 = Hover 1 = Index push/Point 2 = Pinch large 3 = Pinch medium 4 = Pinch small 5 = Pinch lateral 6 = Press all/Fist 7 = Toggle lever up/down 8 = Thumb push 9 = Holde yoke thin 10 = Hold throttle 11 = Hold yokes 12 = Push/pull lever

simvars.name: HIDE AVATAR IN AIRCRAFT
simvars.description: Return the status of the hide_avatar variable from the aircraft.cfg file.

simvars.name: IDLE ANIMATION ID
simvars.description: The ID of the idle animation for the sim object. Not used by the simulation.

simvars.name: MAGVAR
simvars.description: Magnetic variation. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position, regardless of where the camera is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: PARACHUTE OPEN
simvars.description: This will be TRUE if the parachute has opened and FALSE otherwise. Currently this is only applied to the Parachute SimObject used by Winches.

simvars.name: REALISM CRASH DETECTION
simvars.description: True indicates crash detection is turned on.

simvars.name: REALISM CRASH WITH OTHERS
simvars.description: True indicates crashing with other aircraft is possible.

simvars.name: SIM ON GROUND
simvars.description: On ground flag. NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all far aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: SIM SHOULD SET ON GROUND
simvars.description: This is a "read only" flag that is only ever used internally and has no use to third parties. If you need to know if the user aircraft is on the ground then use IS ON GROUND, and if you need to set the aircraft on the ground then use SIMCONNECT_DATA_INITPOSITION.

simvars.name: TRACK IR ENABLE
simvars.description: Returns true if Track IR is enabled or not.

simvars.name: TOTAL WORLD VELOCITY
simvars.description: Speed relative to the earths center.

simvars.name: USER INPUT ENABLED
simvars.description: Is input allowed from the user.

simvars.name: VELOCITY WORLD X
simvars.description: Speed relative to earth, in East/West direction. NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all far aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: VELOCITY WORLD Y
simvars.description: Speed relative to earth, in vertical direction. NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all far aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: VELOCITY WORLD Z
simvars.description: Speed relative to earth, in North/South direction. NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all far aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: VR GROUP INTERACTION ON
simvars.description: This will return 1 (TRUE) if VR is on and group interaction is on. Otherwise it will return 0 (FALSE).

simvars.name: PYLON COLLISION POSITION
simvars.description: Distance to the collision object relative to the pylon.

simvars.name: AMBIENT DENSITY
simvars.description: Ambient density. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position, regardless of where the camera is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: AMBIENT IN CLOUD
simvars.description: True if the aircraft is in a cloud.

simvars.name: AMBIENT IN SMOKE
simvars.description: True if the camera position is flying through smoke. Note that if this is true, then the aircraft will be taking increased Wear and Tear damage. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the camera position, regardless of where the user aircraft is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: AMBIENT PRECIP RATE
simvars.description: The current precipitation rate. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position, regardless of where the camera is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: AMBIENT PRECIP STATE
simvars.description: The current state of precipitation. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position, regardless of where the camera is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: AMBIENT PRESSURE
simvars.description: Ambient pressure. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position, regardless of where the camera is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: AMBIENT TEMPERATURE
simvars.description: Ambient temperature. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position, regardless of where the camera is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: AMBIENT VISIBILITY
simvars.description: Ambient visibility (only measures ambient particle visibility - related to ambient density).

simvars.name: AMBIENT WIND DIRECTION
simvars.description: Wind direction, relative to true north. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position, regardless of where the camera is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: AMBIENT WIND VELOCITY
simvars.description: Wind velocity. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position, regardless of where the camera is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: AMBIENT WIND X
simvars.description: Wind component in East/West direction. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position, regardless of where the camera is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: AMBIENT WIND Y
simvars.description: Wind component in vertical direction. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position, regardless of where the camera is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: AMBIENT WIND Z
simvars.description: Wind component in North/South direction. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position, regardless of where the camera is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: BAROMETER PRESSURE
simvars.description: Barometric pressure. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position, regardless of where the camera is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: DENSITY ALTITUDE
simvars.description: The density altitude is the altitude relative to standard atmospheric conditions at which the air density would be equal to the indicated air density at the place of observation. The calculation is as follows: density_altitude = pressure_altitude + 118.8 * (outside_air_temp - ISA_temp)

simvars.name: ENV CLOUD DENSITY
simvars.description: This SimVar returns the current density of the clouds at the position of the user aircraft. Density is expressed as a value between 0 and 1, where 0 is no clouds, and 1 is very dense cloud. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position, regardless of where the camera is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: ENV SMOKE DENSITY
simvars.description: This SimVar returns the current density of any smoke at the position of the camera. Density is expressed as a value between 0 and 1, where 0 is no smoke, and 1 is very dense smoke. Note that if this value is greater than 0 then the user aircraft will be taking Wear and Tear damage, and the higher the value the more damage will be taken. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the camera position, regardless of where the user aircraft is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: SEA LEVEL AMBIENT TEMPERATURE
simvars.description: The ambient temperature of the air at sea level. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position, regardless of where the camera is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: SEA LEVEL PRESSURE
simvars.description: Barometric pressure at sea level. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position, regardless of where the camera is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: STRUCT AMBIENT WIND
simvars.description: X (latitude), Y (vertical) and Z (longitude) components of the wind. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position, regardless of where the camera is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: AI DESIRED SPEED
simvars.description: The desired speed of the AI object.

simvars.name: AI WAYPOINT LIST
simvars.description: A list of waypoints that an AI controlled object should follow.

simvars.name: AI CURRENT WAYPOINT
simvars.description: The current waypoint in the list.

simvars.name: AI DESIRED HEADING
simvars.description: The desired heading of the AI object.

simvars.name: AI GROUNDTURNTIME
simvars.description: The time required by the AI aircraft to make a 90º turn.

simvars.name: AI GROUNDCRUISESPEED
simvars.description: The ground cruising speed for the AI aircraft.

simvars.name: AI GROUNDTURNSPEED
simvars.description: The ground turning speed for the AI aircraft.

simvars.name: AI TRAFFIC ISIFR
simvars.description: This can be used to request whether the AI aircraft is IFR or VFR. Note that if an aircraft does not have a flight plan, the value returned will be 0 (or false).

simvars.name: AI TRAFFIC STATE
simvars.description: This will return a string describing an AI aircraft state. If the aircraft is under ATC control the string will be one of the following: "init" "sleep" "flt plan" "startup" "preflight support" "clearance" "push back 1" "push back 2" "pre taxi out" "taxi out" "takeoff 1" "takeoff 2" "T&G depart" "enroute" "pattern" "landing" "rollout" "go around" "taxi in" "shutdown" "postflight support" If the aircraft is not under ATC control, the string will be one of these: "Sleep" "Waypoint" "Takeoff" "Landing" "Taxi" Note that if an aircraft does not have a flight plan, the value returned will be an empty string "".

simvars.name: AI TRAFFIC CURRENT AIRPORT
simvars.description: The ICAO code of the current airport. If an aircraft does not have a flight plan, the value returned will be an empty string "".

simvars.name: AI TRAFFIC ASSIGNED RUNWAY
simvars.description: The assigned runway name (for example: "32R"). If an aircraft does not have a flight plan, the value returned will be an empty string "".

simvars.name: AI TRAFFIC ASSIGNED PARKING
simvars.description: The assigned parking name. The string will take the form: Name + Number, Type ( radius ) For example: "Ramp 1, RAMP sml (10m)" "Gate G 4, RAMP lrg (18m)" If an aircraft does not have a flight plan, the value returned will be an empty string "".

simvars.name: AI TRAFFIC FROMAIRPORT
simvars.description: The ICAO code of the departure airport in the current schedule. This variable is only valid for aircraft generated by the traffic database that have schedules. If an aircraft does not have a schedule, the value returned will an empty string"".

simvars.name: AI TRAFFIC TOAIRPORT
simvars.description: The ICAO code of the destination airport in the current schedule. This variable is only valid for aircraft generated by the traffic database that have schedules. If an aircraft does not have a schedule, the value returned will an empty string"".

simvars.name: AI TRAFFIC ETD
simvars.description: The estimated time of departure for the current schedule entry, given as the number of seconds difference from the current simulation time. This can be negative if ETD is earlier than the current simulation time This variable is only valid for aircraft generated by the traffic database that have schedules. If an aircraft does not have a schedule, the value returned will be 0.

simvars.name: AI TRAFFIC ETA
simvars.description: Estimated time of arrival for the current schedule entry, given as the number of seconds difference from the current simulated time. This can be negative if ETA is earlier than the current simulated time. This variable is only valid for aircraft generated by the traffic database that have schedules. If an aircraft does not have a schedule, the value returned will be 0.

simvars.name: STRUCT REALISM VARS

simvars.name: STRUCT WORLD ACCELERATION
