simvars.name: ABSOLUTE TIME
units: This returns the seconds since 12:00 am 1/1/1AD Zulu Time See the Note On Zulu Time for more information.

simvars.name: ZULU TIME
units: This returns the seconds since midnight (00:00 Zulu Time) on the current day.

simvars.name: ZULU DAY OF WEEK
units: This returns the current Zulu Time day of the week as an integer value between 0 and 6 (inclusive)
where 0 is Sunday and 6 is Saturday. See the Note On Zulu Time for more information.

simvars.name: ZULU DAY OF MONTH
units: This returns the current Zulu Time day of the month as an integer value between 1 and 31 (inclusive). See the Note On Zulu Time for more information.

simvars.name: ZULU MONTH OF YEAR
units: This returns the current Zulu Time month of the year as an integer value between 1 and 12 (inclusive)
where 1 is January and 12 is December. See the Note On Zulu Time for more information.

simvars.name: ZULU DAY OF YEAR
units: This returns the current Zulu Time day of the year as an integer value between 0 and 365 (365 only on a leap year). See the Note On Zulu Time for more information.

simvars.name: ZULU YEAR
units: This returns the current Zulu Time year as an integer value. See the Note On Zulu Time for more information.

simvars.name: ZULU SUNRISE TIME
units: This returns the seconds since midnight until the sunrise based on Zulu Time. See the Note On Zulu Time for more information.

simvars.name: ZULU SUNSET TIME
units: This returns the seconds since midnight until the sunset based on Zulu Time. See the Note On Zulu Time for more information.

simvars.name: LOCAL TIME
units: This returns the seconds since midnight (00:00 local time) on the current day.

simvars.name: LOCAL DAY OF WEEK
units: This returns the current day of the week as an integer value between 0 and 6 (inclusive)
where 0 is Sunday and 6 is Saturday

simvars.name: LOCAL DAY OF MONTH
units: This returns the current day of the month as an integer value between 1 and 31 (inclusive)

simvars.name: LOCAL MONTH OF YEAR
units: This returns the current month of the year as an integer value between 1 and 12 (inclusive)
where 1 is January and 12 is December

simvars.name: LOCAL DAY OF YEAR
units: This returns the current day of the year as an integer value between 0 and 365 (365 only on a leap year)

simvars.name: LOCAL YEAR
units: This returns the current year (local time) as an integer value.

simvars.name: TIME ZONE OFFSET
units: This returns the offset between the local time and Zulu Time. See the Note On Zulu Time for more information.

simvars.name: TIME OF DAY
units: This will return an integer value representing the approximate time of day where: 0 = dawn 1 = day 2 = dusk 3 = night

simvars.name: TOOLTIP UNITS
units: This will return an integer value representing the current units used to display tooltip information

simvars.name: UNITS OF MEASURE
units: This indicates the units used to express measurements and will return an integer value representing the following: 0 - English 1 - Metric with altitude in feet 2 - Metric with altitude in meters

simvars.name: SIMULATION RATE
units: This is used to get/set the internal rate of passing time within the simulation(independently of the visual frame rate). The value will be clamped between 0.0625 and 128
and a value of 1 means that 1 second of game time is the same as 1 second of "real" time
and lower values will make the game time slower
and higher values will make the game time faster. Values are always multiples of two starting at 0.0625

simvars.name: SIMULATION TIME
units: This returns a value for the seconds since the simulation has been started.

simvars.name: SIMULATION DELTA TIME
units: This returns a value for the time passed between the last simulation frame and the current one.

simvars.name: IS IN VR
units: This returns either 1 (TRUE) or 0 (FALSE) to indicate whether the simulation is in VR mode or not.

simvars.name: IS USING MOTION CONTROLLERS
units: This returns either 1 (TRUE) or 0 (FALSE) to indicate whether the user is using 6DoF controllers in VR or not.

simvars.name: IS USING JOYSTICK THROTTLE
units: This returns either 1 (TRUE) or 0 (FALSE) to indicate whether the user is manipulating the throttle with a joystick device or not.

simvars.name: IS IN RTC
units: This returns either 1 (TRUE) or 0 (FALSE) to indicate whether the simulation is currently running an RTC or not.

simvars.name: IS AVATAR
units: This returns either 1 (TRUE) or 0 (FALSE) to indicate whether the user is in "Avatar" mode or not.

simvars.name: IS AIRCRAFT
units: This returns either 1 (TRUE) or 0 (FALSE) to indicate whether the user is in "Aircraft" mode or not.

simvars.name: IS CAMERA LOCKED
units: This returns either 1 (TRUE) or 0 (FALSE) to indicate whether the camera is locked or not.

simvars.name: EFB BRIGHTNESS
units: This return the brightness of the EFB
from 0 to 1. If it is set to "auto brightness" within the EFB's settings

simvars.name: SWITCH USER ALWAYS ALLOWED
units: This returns either 1 (TRUE) or 0 (FALSE) to indicate whether there is no limitation to switch between avatar and aircraft mode or not.
